<parameter name="content"># checkout-service

Next.js 14 (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind, Prisma on Postgres. Owned by the payments squad.

## Money
- All amounts are integer cents. Never use floats for money (a 2024 float-rounding incident corrupted invoices).

## Tests
- `npm run test:unit` runs unit tests.
- `npm test` runs the Playwright E2E suite and fails unless a dev server is already running.

## Migrations
- Always use `./scripts/migrate.sh`. Never run `prisma migrate` directly; it breaks the shadow database CI relies on.

## Auth
- API routes authenticate with a custom `X-Session-Token` header, not Bearer tokens. Scheme is documented in `docs/api.md`.

## Code style
- Standard TypeScript style, with two exceptions:
  - No default exports.
  - Zod schemas live next to their route handlers.
- Full guide (long; consult only when needed): `docs/style-guide.md`.
